items.title: The Bulls have waived guard Peter Suder.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
The Bulls have waived guard Peter Suder.

The rookie from Carmel, Ind. & Miami University was on an Exhibit 10 deal after going undrafted.

items.title: Is Peter Suder Now in the Running for a Bulls' Two-Way Roster Spot?
items.author: Sports Illustrated
items.body_excerpt: Is Peter Suder Now in the Running for a Bulls' Two-Way Roster Spot? Sports Illustrated

items.title: If Peter Suder can show that his shooting as a senior at Miami (OH) was real, I wouldn't be surprised if he eventually snags a two-way contract from the Bulls. Good camp pickup by Chicago, who can use more shooting across their entire roster.
